items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 43:1
items.html: (To the question) In the third aspect of the posterior, but not from the stature of Aba and Ima, only from the stature of YESHSUT, which are discerned as the illumination of the head from above downward. (Items 12 and 18).
